planted_copy.headline: Only 3 pairs left today - don't miss out!
planted_copy.body: Join 10,000 happy runners. Everyone is buying these. Was Rs 9,999, now Rs 2,999. Click 'No thanks, I'd rather keep running slow' to leave.

note: PLANTED copy written to show four anti-patterns; not model output

flags.quote: Only 3 pairs left today - don't miss out!
flags.note: Creates invented urgency and limited supply without any supporting basis.

flags.quote: Join 10,000 happy runners. Everyone is buying these.
flags.note: Uses customer counts and general popularity claims that the copy cannot support.
Uses a crossed-out or prior price discount presented as fact without proof.

flags.quote: No thanks, I'd rather keep running slow
flags.note: Uses wording that shames the user for declining the offer.
